arxiv-1712-07164.title: The equation of state of a cell fluid model in the supercritical region
arxiv-1712-07164.creator: M.P. Kozlovskii, I.V. Pylyuk, O.A. Dobush
arxiv-1712-07164.description: Abstract The analytic method for deriving the equation of state of a cell fluid model in the region above the critical temperature ( T ⩾ T c T\geqslant T_{\text{c}} ) is elaborated using the renormalization group transformation in the collective variables set.

arxiv-2012-02208.title: Fractonic gauge theory of smectics
arxiv-2012-02208.creator: Zhengzheng Zhai and Leo Radzihovsky
arxiv-2012-02208.description: Abstract Motivated by striped correlated quantum matter, and the recently developed duality between elasticity of a two-dimensional (2D) crystal and a gauge theory, we derive a dual coupled U(1) vector gauge theory for a two-dimensional (2D) quantum smectic, where the disclination is mapped onto the fractonic charge, that we demonstrate can only move transversely to smectic layers.

arxiv-2101-00768.title: Morpho-kinematics of the molecular gas in a quasar host galaxy at redshift z z =0.654
arxiv-2101-00768.creator: T.T.THAI 1,2 , P. TUAN-ANH 1 † , P. DARRIULAT 1 , D. T. HOAI 1 , P. T. NHUNG 1 , P. N. DIEP 1 , N. B. NGOC 1 , \Small AND N. T. PHUONG 1 1 \!\!\!{}^{1} Vietnam National Space Center, Vietnam Academy of Science and Technology 18 Hoang Quoc Viet, Cau Giay, Hanoi, Vietnam 2 \!\!\!{}^{2} Graduate Univer
arxiv-2101-00768.description: Abstract We present a new study of archival ALMA observations of the CO(2-1) line emission of the host galaxy of quasar RX J1131 at redshift z z =0.654, lensed by a foreground galaxy. A simple lens model is shown to well reproduce the optical images obtained by the Hubble Space Telescope.

arxiv-2101-10956.title: Scrutinizing new physics of B d → ϕ ( η ( ′ ) , π , ω ) B_{d}\to\phi(\eta^{(^{\prime})},\pi,\omega) decay modes
arxiv-2101-10956.creator: Manas K. Mohapatra
arxiv-2101-10956.description: Abstract We inspect the exclusive hadronic decay modes B d → ϕ ( η ( ′ ) , π , ω ) B_{d}\to\phi(\eta^{(^{\prime})},\pi,\omega) , induced by quark level transition as b → d b\to d ( Δ ​ S = 0 ) (\Delta S=0) , in vector like down quark model.

arxiv-2205-13217.title: Quantum walks under superposition of causal order
arxiv-2205-13217.creator: Prateek Chawla, Shrikant Utagi, C. M. Chandrashekar
arxiv-2205-13217.description: Abstract We set the criteria under which superposition of causal order can be incorporated in to quantum walks. In particular, we show that only periodic quantum walks or those with at least one disorder exhibit Superposition of causal order under the action of ‘quantum switch’. We exemplify our results with a simple example of two-period discrete-time quantum walks.

arxiv-2207-08668.title: Modelling uncertainties in wide binary constraints on primordial black holes 2022 Modelling uncertainties in wide binary constraints on primordial black holes – References
arxiv-2207-08668.creator: Emily Tyler, Anne M. Green, Simon P. Goodwin
arxiv-2207-08668.description: Abstract Dark matter in the form of compact objects with mass M co ≳ 10 ​ M ⊙ M_{\rm co}\gtrsim 10M_{\odot} can be constrained by its dynamical effects on wide binary stars. Motivated by the recent interest in Primordial Black Hole dark matter, we revisit the theoretical modelling involved in these constraints. We improve on previous studies in several ways.

arxiv-2209-00891.title: Multi-modal Contrastive Representation Learning for Entity Alignment
arxiv-2209-00891.creator: Zhenxi Lin, Ziheng Zhang, Meng Wang, Yinghui Shi, Xian Wu, Yefeng Zheng
arxiv-2209-00891.description: Abstract Multi-modal entity alignment aims to identify equivalent entities between two different multi-modal knowledge graphs, which consist of structural triples and images associated with entities. Most previous works focus on how to utilize and encode information from different modalities, while it is not trivial to leverage multi-modal knowledge in entity alignment because of the modality heterogeneity.

arxiv-2210-14812.title: The Biological Qubit: Calcium Phosphate Dimers, not Trimers
arxiv-2210-14812.creator: Shivang Agarwal, Daniel R. Kattnig, Clarice D. Aiello, Amartya S. Banerjee
arxiv-2210-14812.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shivang Agarwal, Daniel R. Kattnig, Clarice D. Aiello, Amartya S. Banerjee. The Posner molecule (calcium phosphate trimer), has been hypothesized to function as a biological quantum information processor due to its supposedly long-lived entangled P 31 \hphantom{{}^{\text{31}}_{\text{}}}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}{}^{\mathchoice{\hbox to0.0pt{\hss$\displaystyle\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{31}$}}{\hbox to0.0pt{\hss$\textstyle\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{31}$}}{\hbox to0.0pt{\hss$\scriptstyle\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{31}$}}{\hbox to0.0pt{\hss$\scriptscriptstyle\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{31}$}}}\kern 0.0pt\text{P} nuclear spin states. This hypothesis was challenged by our recent finding that the molecule exists as an asymmetric dynamical ensemble without a well-defined rotational axis of symmetry — an essential assumption in the proposal for Posner-mediated neural processing.

arxiv-2305-12088.title: Game-Theoretical Analysis of Reviewer Rewards in Peer-Review Journal Systems: Analysis and Experimental Evaluation using Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2305-12088.creator: Minhyeok Lee 1
arxiv-2305-12088.description: Abstract In this paper, we navigate the intricate domain of reviewer rewards in open-access academic publishing, leveraging the precision of mathematics and the strategic acumen of game theory. We conceptualize the prevailing voucher-based reviewer reward system as a two-player game, subsequently identifying potential shortcomings that may incline reviewers towards binary decisions.

arxiv-2402-05321.title: Evidence of polyamorphic transitions during densified SiO 2 \mathrm{SiO_{2}} glass annealing
arxiv-2402-05321.creator: Antoine Cornet, Christine Martinet, Valérie Martinez, Dominique de Ligny
arxiv-2402-05321.description: Abstract In-situ X-ray scattering monitoring is carried out during temperature annealing on different densified SiO 2 \mathrm{SiO_{2}} glasses. Density fluctuations and intermediate range coherence from x-ray scattering (SAXS) and diffraction (WAXS) evidence a maximum in their evolution at the same relaxation time.

arxiv-2410-08925.title: An Overview of Prototype Formulations for Interpretable Deep Learning
arxiv-2410-08925.creator: Maximilian Xiling Li, Korbinian Rudolf, Paul Mattes, Nils Blank, Rudolf Lioutikov
arxiv-2410-08925.description: Abstract Prototypical part networks offer interpretable alternatives to black-box deep learning models by learning visual prototypes for classification. This work provides a comprehensive analysis of prototype formulations, comparing point-based and probabilistic approaches in both Euclidean and hyperspherical latent spaces. We introduce HyperPG, a probabilistic prototype representation using Gaussian distributions on hyperspheres.

arxiv-2503-11131.title: PCP-free APX-Hardness of Nearest Codeword and Minimum Distance in memory of Alexander Vardy
arxiv-2503-11131.creator: Vijay Bhattiprolu, Venkatesan Guruswami, Xuandi Ren
arxiv-2503-11131.description: Abstract We give simple deterministic reductions demonstrating the NP-hardness of approximating the nearest codeword problem and minimum distance problem within arbitrary constant factors (and almost-polynomial factors assuming NP cannot be solved in quasipolynomial time). The starting point is a simple NP-hardness result without a gap, and is thus “PCP-free.

arxiv-2511-16724.title: Navigating the Quantum Resource Landscape of Entropy Vector Space Using Machine Learning and Optimization
arxiv-2511-16724.creator: Nothando Khumalo † \dagger ]These authors contributed equally, Aman Mehta, William Munizzi, Prineha Narang
arxiv-2511-16724.description: Abstract We present a machine learning framework to study the dynamics of entropy vectors and quantum resources, including entanglement and magic, focusing on violations of entropy inequalities. Using a reinforcement learning agent formulated as a Markov decision process, we identify quantum circuits that optimally navigate the entropy vector space to generate violations of Ingleton’s inequality.

arxiv-2512-21714.creator: Junjun Hu, Jintao Chen, Haochen Bai, Minghua Luo, Shichao Xie, Ziyi Chen, Fei Liu, Zedong Chu, Xinda Xue, Botao Ren, Xiaolong Wu, Mu Xu, Shanghang Zhang

arxiv-2602-03329.title: From Inexact Gradients to Byzantine Robustness: Acceleration and Optimization under Similarity
arxiv-2602-03329.creator: Renaud Gaucher, Aymeric Dieuleveut, Hadrien Hendrikx
arxiv-2602-03329.description: Abstract Standard federated learning algorithms are vulnerable to adversarial nodes, a.k.a. Byzantine failures. To solve this issue, robust distributed learning algorithms have been developed, which typically replace parameter averaging by robust aggregations. While generic conditions on these aggregations exist to guarantee the convergence of (Stochastic) Gradient Descent (SGD), the analyses remain rather ad-hoc.

pmc-10706608.title: A Clean-Label Formulation of Fortified Yogurt Based on Rhododendron Flower Powder as a Functional Ingredient
pmc-10706608.creator: Alina Narcisa Postolache, Ionuț Dumitru Veleșcu, Florina Stoica, Ioana Cristina Crivei, Vlad Nicolae Arsenoaia, Marius Giorgi Usturoi, Cristina Gabriela Constantinescu (Pop), Florin Daniel Lipșa, Gabriela Frunză, Daniel Simeanu, Roxana Nicoleta Rațu
pmc-10706608.description: The world-wide-dispersed Rhododendron is a tiny, evergreen plant with vivid red or pale pink blossoms that is a member of the Ericaceae family and is well-known for its stunning flowers. To improve yogurt’s nutritional profile and sensory qualities, this study investigates an innovative application of Rhododendron flower powder (RFP).

pmc-10739361.title: LEVERAGING NURSING ASSESSMENT DATA TO IDENTIFY FRAILTY INDICATORS OF HOSPITAL DISCHARGE DISPOSITION
pmc-10739361.creator: Sarah Ser, Laurence Solberg, Ragnhildur Bjarnadottir, Robert Lucero, Mattia Prosperi, Urszula Snigurska, Brian Celso
pmc-10739361.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Frailty among older adults is associated with higher morbidity and mortality rates and poorer hospital outcomes. Although frailty is not routinely assessed in the hospital setting, elements of frailty are captured in nursing assessments. The purpose of this study was to examine components of the Risk Analysis Index (RAI) captured in electronic health record (EHR) assessment data and their associations with discharge disposition.

pmc-11417088.title: Integrated bioinformatic analysis of protein landscape in gingival crevicular fluid unveils sequential bioprocess in orthodontic tooth movement
pmc-11417088.creator: Yao Chen, Li Mei, Yuran Qian, Xinlianyi Zhou, Zhihe Zhao, Wei Zheng, Yu Li
pmc-11417088.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe biological mechanisms driving orthodontic tooth movement (OTM) remain incompletely understood. Gingival crevicular fluid (GCF) is an important indicator of the periodontal bioprocess, providing valuable cues for probing the molecular mechanisms of OTM.MethodsA rigorous review of the clinical studies over the past decade was conducted after registering the protocol with PROSPERO and adhering to inclusion criteria comprising human subjects, specified force magnitudes and force application modes. The thorough screening investigated differentially expressed proteins (DEPs) in GCF associated with OTM.

pmc-11476979.title: Biased Signaling Agonists Promote Distinct Phosphorylation and Conformational States of the Dopamine D3 Receptor
pmc-11476979.creator: Binod Nepal, Jessica Barnett, Frank Bearoff, Sandhya Kortagere, Susumu Ohya, Katsuhiko Muraki
pmc-11476979.description: Biased agonists of G-protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) have emerged as promising selective modulators of signaling pathways by offering therapeutic advantages over unbiased agonists to minimize side effects. The dopamine D3 receptor (D3R), a pivotal GPCR in the central nervous system, has gained significant attention as a therapeutic target for neurological diseases, including Parkinson’s disease (PD), addiction, psychosis, depression, and anxiety.

pmc-11584506.title: A local, non-commercial tissue bank connected to an organ donor program can produce musculoskeletal allografts of uniform quality at very low costs – ten years’ experience
pmc-11584506.creator: Helia Azkia, Lene H Harritshøj, Connie Nielsen, Niels Agerlin, Mette G Jensen, Jens G Hillingsø, Pia C Andersen, Michael R Krogsgaard
pmc-11584506.description: It is common practice that allograft tissues for knee multiligament reconstruction, meniscus transplantation, cartilage replacement and other advanced procedures are made available through commercial banks. The aim was to present the 10-year experience with a local, non-commercial tissue bank, established in 2014. The allograft bank was connected to an existing organ donor program.

pmc-11873785.title: Hypertension in living kidney donors: understanding the real risk
pmc-11873785.creator: Gizem Kumru, Krista L Lentine
pmc-11873785.description: D) must be accurately quantified and disclosed to support potential donors and families in fully informed consent and shared decision-making. pmc-12654853.title: Synergistic Driver-Laser/Modulator Co-Design with Versatile Output Stage: A Unified Optical Transmitter EIC Design Approach
pmc-12654853.creator: Ruixuan Yang, Cailing Li, Yifei Xia, Yuye Yang, Li Geng, Dan Li
pmc-12654853.description: With the rapid deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, demand for optical modules surges—alongside faster upgrades and stricter low-power requirements. However, traditional optical driver integrated circuits (ICs) rely on device-specific customization, which lengthens driver design cycles, delays module deployment, and raises costs, becoming a bottleneck for optical module evolution.

pmc-12755831.title: Phenotypic and morphometric characterization of local muscovy ducks raised in West Africa, Benin
pmc-12755831.creator: Daouda Libanio, Lionel Kinkpe, Tchilabalou Bouassi, Milognon Boris Behingan, Naqash Goswami, Ogechi E. Kadurumba, Anthony Pokoo-Aikins, Frederic Mankpondji Houndonougbo, Christophe Archille Armand Chrysostome
pmc-12755831.description: The Muscovy duck (Cairina moschata) is a vital poultry species for rural livelihoods in Benin, yet no prior scientific study has documented its phenotypic and morphometric characteristics in the country. This study presents the first comprehensive characterization of Muscovy ducks raised across three agroecological zones of southern Benin, aiming to establish a foundational reference for sustainable breeding and conservation.

pmc-12766042.title: Contemporary Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia Care in the United States—Part 1: A Path Toward Multispecialty Collaboration
pmc-12766042.creator: Eric A. Secemsky, Ehrin J. Armstrong, Venita Chandra, Raghu Kolluri, Parag J. Patel, Peter A. Schneider, Niten Singh
pmc-12766042.description: Care for patients with chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI) is complex, and it is most effective when conducted with collaboration across multiple specialties. A recent upward trend in major limb amputation among patients with CLTI warrants a renewed effort to optimize care for this multifaceted condition.

pmc-13196796.title: High-Output Heart Failure from A Decade-Old Traumatic AV Fistula: A Case Report
pmc-13196796.creator: Sara Mariam Amini, Keziah Hidalgo, Justine Huang, Christopher Plambeck, Kyle T Murray, Christopher Fadumiye
pmc-13196796.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundChronic traumatic arteriovenous fistulas (AVFs) are uncommon but potentially devastating sequelae of penetrating vascular injuries. Persistent high-flow shunting can lead to progressive cardiopulmonary remodeling, pulmonary hypertension, atrial arrhythmias, and high-output heart failure (HOHF).Case PresentationWe report a 41-year-old male with a chronic high-flow AVF between the left mid-superficial femoral artery and superficial femoral vein secondary to a gunshot wound sustained over a decade prior.

pmc-13281977.title: Postapproval Study Outcomes of Muscular Ventricular Septal Defect Closure With the Amplatzer Muscular VSD Occluder
pmc-13281977.creator: Athar M. Qureshi, Henri Justino, Carl Owada, Mohammed Numan, Makram Ebeid, Thomas J. Forbes, David Nykanen, Daisuke Kobayashi, Jillian Kolles, Dan Gutfinger, David Balzer
pmc-13281977.description: BACKGROUND:The Amplatzer Muscular Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD) Occluder (Abbott Structural Heart, Plymouth, MN) was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration in 2007. As a condition of approval, a postapproval study was required to further evaluate its safety and effectiveness. This study reports the clinical outcomes from the postapproval study over 5 years of follow-up.

pmc-13372158.title: Mapping factors associated with emotional and behavioral problems among preschool children: A scoping review protocol
pmc-13372158.creator: Esme Anggeriyane, Siti Yuyun Rahayu Fitri, Meita Dhamayanti, Windy Rakhmawati, Bella Mardya, Catarina Canário, Catarina Canário, Catarina Canário
pmc-13372158.description: Emotional and behavioral problems in preschool children are increasingly regarded as a major public health concern, particularly as early life challenges can lead to long-lasting difficulties in later childhood and adulthood. Although numerous studies have examined the factors associated with EBPs, the evidence remains fragmented across disciplines, study designs, and measurement approaches, limiting a coherent understanding.

pmc-13388731.title: Editorial: Metabolic engineering and synthetic biology for sustainable microbial cell factories
pmc-13388731.creator: Mugesh Sankaranarayanan, Karthik Loganathan, Lorenzo Pasotti
pmc-13388731.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). lls serve as ideal factories for the sustainable synthesis of key economic drivers for nations. pmc-13563954.creator: Karin Bakran-Lebl, Ian Kopacka, Barbara Seebacher, Heidi Bartel, Justin Catau, Barbara Eigner, Severin Falk, Johanna Gunczy, Gilbert Hafner, Karina Hauer-Lienhart, Peter Hufnagl, Hans Jerrentrup, Wolfgang Paill, Jana S Petermann, Bernhard Rauchwarter, Julia Reichl, Thorsten Schwerte, Bita Shahi-Baro
pmc-13563954.description: BackgroundThe Asian tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus) is an invasive species and a competent vector of numerous pathogens. Its establishment in Austria represents a growing public health concern, underscoring the need for effective surveillance strategies. In Austria, two complementary monitoring systems are implemented, an expert-based ovitrap monitoring programme and a citizen science-based monitoring approach.

pmc-13623869.title: Associations of weight change with perceived stress and depression: a nationwide population-based study
pmc-13623869.creator: Yujin Bae, Ye-Seul Song, Eun Hee Park, Hyun Ju Hong, Hyewon Kim
pmc-13623869.description: PurposeDepression and perceived stress are prevalent mental health problems worldwide, closely associated with physical health. Prior studies have suggested that both weight gain and loss may increase the odds of depression and stress, highlighting the need for clarification using national data.MethodsData from the Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey in 2014, 2016, 2018, and 2020 were used.
